cat > /workspace/tmp/find_zero_terminal.py <<'PY'
import random,importlib.util,itertools,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(s)
random.seed(777)
t0=time.time()
for trial in range(2000000):
    npaths=random.randint(1,20)
    nv=random.randint(3,15)
    cp={}
    for _ in range(npaths):
        L=random.randint(2,min(10,nv))
        p=tuple(random.sample(range(1,nv+1),L))
        cp[p]=cp.get(p,0)+random.randint(1,5)
    rounds,cur,core=s.peel(cp)
    if rounds: continue
    edges=sorted(core)
    if not(1<=len(edges)<=20):continue
    ei={e:i for i,e in enumerate(edges)}
    sc,occ=s.build_scopes_and_occurrences(cur,ei)
    fac=s.make_factors(len(edges),sc,occ)
    # VE with order sorted; may be expensive but okay small
    pos=list(range(len(edges)))
    Z=s.run_ve(fac,len(edges),pos)
    if Z==0:
        print('FOUND ZERO terminal trial',trial,'cp',cp,'edges',edges,'sc',sc)
        print('time',time.time()-t0);break
else:print('none; time',time.time()-t0)
PY
cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 -u tmp/find_zero_terminal.py; echo rc=$?
